[[syntax trees at end of                     typer]] // LocalValues.scala
package lexicalclosure {
  final lazy module val LocalValues: lexicalclosure.LocalValues =
    new lexicalclosure.LocalValues()
  final module class LocalValues() extends Object() {
    this: lexicalclosure.LocalValues.type =>
    def offset: Int => Int =
      {
        val bias: Int = 3
        (x: Int) =>
          {
            x + bias
          }
      }
    def two: Int => Int =
      {
        val first: Int = 1
        val second: Int = 2
        (x: Int) =>
          {
            x + first + second + first
          }
      }
    def shadowed: Int => Int =
      {
        val value: Int = 100
        (value: Int) =>
          {
            value
          }
      }
    def nestedShadow: Int => Int =
      {
        val value: Int = 100
        {
          val value: Int = 3
          (x: Int) =>
            {
              x + value
            }
        }
      }
  }
}
